children: Copley Acquisition Corp. and Ignite Proteomics Holdings have called off their merger.
The blank-check company and the oncology firm agreed to mutually terminate the merger last week, according to a Tuesday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The merger, announced in June, would have taken Ignite public.

Copley intends to continue pursuing a merger, according to the filing. It currently has until Nov. 2 to reach a new agreement, but that date is subject to extension pursuant to the company's organizational documents.
